description: M4-12: retrain the M4-01 causal lookahead GRU-CTC decoder (fidetype.decoders.lookahead_gru, model unchanged) on B2T '25 T15 with a training recipe close to the published baseline, then rerun the M4-02 accuracy + emission stages. See plan.md.
dataset: Card et al. 2024 (NEJM), t15_copyTask_neuralData.zip, Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.dncjsxm85 (CC0 1.0). Same derived files as M4-01/02 (same prep, same splits).

splits.train: the dataset 'train' trials of all sessions (8,065 used)
splits.val_select: dataset 'val' trials with an even index inside their session (checkpoint selection only)
splits.val_eval: dataset 'val' trials with an odd index inside their session (all reported numbers; 701 trials)

shared.note: L drawn uniformly from {0,2,5,10,15,25} bins per batch (as M4-01)

dedicated_10.note: 200 ms; optional in the plan, required by the 2026-11-14 addendum
